Activate 1 (manipulate)

This metal canister of explosive compounds is inspired by the blastpack, simplifying the technology for day-to-day use—though only a goblin could say what daily tasks warrant such a tool. Each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] from you takes the 4d6 fire damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:34|basic] save; a creature who fails the save is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone]. Then, you Fly up to 30 feet and land prone; this movement doesn't trigger reactions.
